terms.gloss: in a pinch, in a crisis
evidence: Traupman 105: in a pinch, in rē dubiā
terms.comment: Traupman’s phrase. Lewis & Short quotes in rē dubiā only of a doubtful question to be decided (Gell. 6.5.8, s.v. putō), not of a crisis; for “if need be”, sī opus erit is the plain classical way.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 105.
